description: This source file implements a firmware utility for TP-Link devices, including functions for creating, inspecting, and extracting firmware images, with detailed structures for firmware headers and flash layouts, and command-line options for customization.

classes.name: fw_header
classes.description: Represents the firmware header structure containing version info, hardware identifiers, MD5 checksums, and offsets for firmware components.

classes.name: board_info
classes.description: Contains hardware and layout identifiers, including hardware ID, revision, additional version, layout ID, header version, and flags.

methods.name: check_options
methods.description: Validates command-line options and input files, setting up firmware parameters and layout configurations.

methods.name: fill_header
methods.description: Populates a buffer with a firmware header structure, setting version, hardware info, checksums, offsets, and MD5 hash.

methods.name: inspect_fw
methods.description: Reads and inspects a firmware file, verifying header integrity, MD5 checksums, and optionally extracting kernel and rootfs images.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that processes command-line arguments, performs validation, and executes firmware build or inspection routines.
